payload.title: An approved self_change proposal cannot become a branch or a pull request on main: plan_apply_worktree refuses kind self_change by naming a kernel-change lane that is not in the tree, and approve_proposal, plan_apply_worktree and request_kernel_change have no non-test caller
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:88-89 (plan_apply_worktree raises that kernel self-change proposals require the dedicated kernel-change lane)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/apply_engine.py:73-77 (plan_apply_worktree, the only apply entry the operator lane has)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/proposal.py:115-120 (approve_proposal, the operator approval writer; no caller outside tests, CLI or workflows)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/self_modification.py:19-28 (request_kernel_change, which authorizes a kernel edit; no caller outside tests)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/self_improvement.py:380-387 (kernel_change_lane is named in RAIL_MODULES by its planned path; no such module exists in aria_kernel)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/self_change_bridge.py:168-194 (the bridge mints the proposal and parks the mission; nothing downstream carries it)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept and make it automatic (tier 2): a path the kernel mints a proposal for must have an executor, or the proposal must not be minted
payload.notes: The self-change path mints a proposal and an adjudication and parks the mission, and after an operator approves, no kernel code path turns the approved proposal into a worktree, a branch or a draft PR: plan_apply_worktree raises for kind self_change and names a lane module that git ls-tree at this revision does not hold (it exists only on a branch that is far behind main), approve_proposal and request_kernel_change are never called outside tests, and git grep finds no workflow or CLI verb that calls them. The delivery, merge, outcome and revert segments therefore never receive a change from the self-improvement lane. Plan row: F0.4c (the audit names it, built on landing/aria-kc-l, not rebased on main). Close condition: The kernel change lane lands (kernel_change_lane.py with admit_kernel_change) and plan_apply_worktree hands a self_change proposal to it instead of raising; a test approves a self_change proposal through the new CLI verb that calls approve_proposal and asserts a branch and a change_ledger row exist, and an invariant fails when a module named in RAIL_MODULES does not exist in aria_kernel. Plan row: F0.4c (kernel change lane, not on main). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
